signals.title: Harley-Davidson’s most affordable motorcycle is expected to be revealed soon
signals.summary: The new Harley-Davidson ‘Sprint’ is edging closer to a global launch despite the company’s latest tease revealing no new information. With shows like EICMA and MCL26 right around the corner, there’s a chance we could get to know the new Harley-Davidson ‘Sprint’ motorcycle on a much deeper level. So far, the American company has revealed teasers of the new model on social media, although information about the bike, and its hardware, have remained very limited. That being said, we can pull specs from Harley’s X440 platform to understand a little more about the upcoming model, which is expected to arrive as Harley’s most affordable motorcycle in the UK, and other markets worldwide. Harley’s X440, which is currently vacant from various big markets globally, is currently sold across parts of Asia. The X440 is manufactured by Hero at its plant in Rajasthan, India, and is closely related to Hero’s own Hunk 440. You might be interested in reading our Hero Hunk 440 review . It still remains to be seen how closely related the new ‘Sprint’ will be to both the Hunk 440 and X440, both of which make use of an air-cooled single-cylinder engine. We would expect the new Sprint model to feature the same power unit, meaning bhp and torque figures will likely be comparable, if not the same. For a long time, Harley’s ability to get new riders on seats has proved somewhat tricky. Some of that is related to the cost of its motorcycles, while in other cases, the lack of entry-level bikes has also been a factor. However, those two points are where the Sprint could not only help the American brand sell more motorcycles, but also help grow its appeal in a segment that is very popular at the moment. If we take the modern classic segment in the UK, for example, the bikes generally performing the best over the last two years operate within the 350cc to 400cc category. Small-to-mid displacement motorcycles have become some of the most popular in various markets in recent times, and by entering that space, Harley’s outlook could look better than it has in many years. Harley has not given any indication as to when the bike will be revealed, but with EICMA set to get underway on November 3, we could find out more then. signals.title: Zero biker sets a new electric motorcycle distance record, with a twist
signals.summary: Zero Motorcycles has set a new Guinness World Record for the longest journey completed by an electric motorcycle on a single charge. Zero Motorcycles has broken the Guinness World Record for the longest journey by an electric motorcycle on a single charge, after Jelle Verstaen completed a surprising 271-mile trip. The motorcyclist covered 271.23 miles on a standard Zero DS, which took him through the French-Italian Alps to the Mediterranean coast. The achievement by Verstaen surpasses the previous record of 193 miles by exactly 78.17 miles, which equates to an increased distance of around 40 per cent. The previous record was set in March 2025 by Verge Motorcycles’ TS Pro, with the ride taking place around Greater London. Although it remained unmodified, the motorcycle used by Verstaen was equipped with the optional Power Tank. The new record is particularly impressive as it goes far beyond the expected range available. The DS achieves a claimed city range of 155 miles from its 15.6kWh battery. Meanwhile, the addition of the Power Tank is good for a further 3.6kWh, bringing its total capacity to 19.2 kWh. Therefore, covering 271 miles goes far beyond what the company’s published range figures suggest is capable. Zero also says that the new Guinness World Record was not part of any ‘laboratory test’, while it was completed strictly on public roads, including minor roads and the French equivalent of A and B roads. This means the 271-mile trip did not include motorway riding. Jarno Middelbosch, Senior Director of Global Marketing at Zero Motorcycles, said this about the new record: “We've spent 20 years pushing the limits of electric motorcycle technology, and our community has ridden millions of kilometres to prove it. This new record is proof that our focus on performance never wavers. Range anxiety remains a hurdle for prospective riders - by proving a real-world range of over 270 miles on a single charge, we're showing what's possible to welcome the next generation of riders to Zero Motorcycles.” Find the latest motorcycle news on Visordown.com Stay up to speed with the latest motorcycling news and analysis, delivered straight to your inbox. A one-of-a-kind 2000 Bourget custom, inspired by Shadow the Hedgehog from Sega's iconic Sonic the Hedgehog franchise, shattered its estimate at last weekend’s Bonhams Autumn Stafford sale. The ‘Dark Rider - Year of Shadow’ motorcycle eventually sold for £210,000 on Sunday, October 11, after it was only expected to sell for around £10,000 to £15,000. The custom motorcycle was donated to former MotoGP rider, and 2014 WorldSBK champion, Sylvain Guintoli, in support of the Luca Guintoli foundation. The foundation was set up in 2025 for Guintoli’s son, Luca, who tragically passed away at the age of six last summer, following a near year-long battle with cancer. The foundation is designed to promote and protect the physical and mental health of children that suffer from autism or cancer, alongside their families in England and Wales. It does this through financial assistance, support, education, and practical advice. All proceeds from the bike’s sale went to the foundation, which was the second-highest-selling motorcycle at the auction, behind a Brough Superior SS100 which sold for £327,750. By fetching a price of £210,000, the 1,750cc motorcycle sold for nearly 15 times more than its original estimate. The Bourget's Bike Works custom build was produced by Sega in connection with Oil Sweat & Gears and Atmospherics SFX. According to the auction listing from Bonhams, this was the first time that a piece of Sega memorabilia, coming directly from the company, was offered for sale at auction. After teasing a new mid-size tall-rounder earlier this month, Kawasaki has since delivered on said tease, with the all-new Versys 900. When we brought you the news that Kawasaki had something special lined-up, a new Versys model was at the top of our predictions list. The new Versys 900 gains the same 948cc inline-four engine inspired by Team Green’s supernaked Z range, which is housed by the Z900. Described as Kawasaki’s most sporty Versys model to date, the new 900 model will produce a claimed 120.3bhp at 9,500rpm and 71.8 Ib-ft of torque at 8,000rpm. Then there’s the Versys 900 SE, which is also available in two colourways, and with Kawasaki genuine accessories, including compact LED fog lamps, hand guards, grip heaters, radiator screen, frame protection sliders and a lower cowl plus centre stand. Housed in a brand-new trellis chassis, the Versys 900 claims to offer a near 50:50 front-to-rear weight distribution. The new model also gains the combination of long-travel suspension and sporty 17-inch wheels shod with Metzeler Roadtec 01 tyres. It features a seven-position adjustable screen and height-adjustable seat (ranging from 825mm to 845mm). Additionally, the new model is equipped with ARAS (Advanced Rider Assistance Systems), including Adaptive Cruise Control Lite (ACC Lite), Forward Collision Warning (FCW) and Blind Spot Detection (BSD). An emergency Stop Signal (ESS) is also part of the setup to help reduce the risk of rear-end collisions. Information is displayed via a full-colour 5-inch TFT display that can be paired with the rider’s smartphone to offer turn-by-turn navigation. As standard, the Versys 900 also features KCMF (Cornering Management Function), KTRC (Traction Control), Enhanced ABS, various power modes and integrated riding modes, as well as a quickshifter. Finally, the Versys 900 and SE models can both be equipped with an additional 47-litre accessory top case, and two 32-litre side panniers. signals.summary: Honda has begun offering free 3D models of popular Honda motorcycles to creators. Drawing or producing CG motorcycles can be challenging due to their complex forms. Many creators have shared that the difficulty of accurately depicting motorcycles sometimes leads them to avoid including them in their art works. This initiative began launched in response to those voices. As a company that develops, manufactures, and sells motorcycles, Honda is home to many passionate motorcycle enthusiasts. Employees across generations have been inspired by stories featuring motorcycles from different eras. By providing official assets from the company that builds motorcycles, Honda hopes more creators will incorporate motorcycles into their projects, leading to even more works in which motorcycles play a role. The 3D data provided are not simple exterior replicas. In actual vehicle development, after a design proposal is created, full-scale modeling and digital data are refined back and forth in millimeter increments. The form and materials are repeatedly verified while incorporating riding data. The assets are produced based on the 3D data finalized through real-world development, allowing for precise reproduction of each motorcycle’s details. This year’s theme was "Nicest People on a Super Cub," in the hope of bringing smiles to the faces of Super Cub owners and onlookers alike. The window displayed a poster of the 1963 U.S. ”Nicest People” campaign. Inside the plaza, the CA100 photographed in the poster was on display. Participants were given the red carpet treatment. Unique numbers were attached to each, later to be used for voting. Some Super Cub-licensed merchandise was also on display, popular with kids and the elderly alike. In “Bike Forum,” a popular talk session at the Cafe Cub meeting, speakers discussed the past, present and future of the Super Cub, celebrating Honda’s 75th, and the Super Cub’s 65th anniversaries. Nonfiction author Hiroshi Nakabe (left) and Miki Press president Kenichi Kobayashi (right) were guest speakers. Both have been involved in publishing many books about the Super Cub. They spoke about how the Super Cub, a high-performance scooter for ordinary people developed with the passion of its founders, Soichiro Honda and Takeo Fujisawa, took off around the world. Another highlight of the Cafe Cub meeting, the Special Award ceremony, in which the Super Cub and its owner selected by Bike Forum guests and Honda Smile associates received commemorative gifts. And, the winners of voting casted by all participants was also awarded. Saturday’s winner was a Super Cub 110 owner. The underground parking at Honda’s Aoyama building was open to the public for the event. 500 vehicles arrived during the two days. The second-floor lobby was opened as a rest space with book and video areas. On Sunday, the area was used to dry helmets and raincoats due to the heavy rain. As a finale to the Cafe Cub meeting, participants tested their paper-scissor-stone skills to win gorgeous prizes. Once Honda Smile associates asked participants to ride home safely, the event came to a close.Participants left with fond memories and promises to reunite with their friends, exchanging information on customization, and listening to historical occurrences at Bike Forum.

signals.title: Ducati Panigale V4, when every detail matters
signals.summary: Ducati updates the Panigale V4 to enhance the bike ’ s performance potential and help riders make even better use of it. The result is a more capable motorcycle (0.4 seconds faster per lap at Vallelunga) that is also easier to ride at the limit. The Desmosedici Stradale engine now delivers 218 hp and 120.6 Nm of torque, thanks to a revised exhaust system, a new higher-flow air intake (+0.6% at 300 km/h) and a lubrication circuit designed to reduce power losses. At the same time, the final drive ratio has been lengthened (17/42 instead of 16/41), increasing top speed by 12 km/h. The rev limiter now cuts in at 15,000 rpm, 500 rpm higher than before. On the chassis front, the main change concerns the Front Frame, whose lateral stiffness has been reduced by 12% to improve steering precision. The V4 S version also features new clip-on handlebars adjustable for track use, while the fairing gains redesigned winglets. The electronics package of the new Panigale V4 S has also taken a step forward. The main addition is Dynamic Engine Brake, which enhances stability under braking when the bike is leaned over and improves rider confidence. Another new feature is Race Brake Control, which makes the rear brake more effective during braking. Finally, the 2027 Panigale V4 S joins the Ducati Factory Made programme, allowing the motorcycle to be customised directly at the factory. signals.title: Shark Skwal iCup, Motorsport-inspired full-face helmet
signals.summary: Since 2015, Shark has been incorporating LED technology into its helmets, gradually developing its applications. At EICMA 2026, the French brand is presenting the Shark Skwal iCup , a full-face helmet inspired by Motorsport. The Shark Skwal iCup combines a sporty, Formula 1-inspired design with a High-Impact Lexan polycarbonate shell, available in two sizes. The profile features a rear spoiler incorporating a vertical LED light signature , which is transparent when off and red when active. The system includes a smart brake light, activated by an accelerometer that detects deceleration without requiring any wired or Bluetooth connections to the motorbike. Three lighting modes are available: position lights, smart brake light and flashing mode. Battery life is approximately 12 hours in flashing mode, whilst recharging takes around three hours. The helmet features multi-density EPS, four air intakes and two exhaust vents, an Optical Class 1 scratch-resistant visor with Pinlock 70 and a sun visor. The interior is removable, the fastening is a double-ring system, and the helmet is compatible with the Sena for Shark intercom. ECE 22.06-approved, it joins the Skwal i3 full-face helmet and the Skwal i3 Jet, designed for urban use, with which it shares the same LED technology. signals.title: LABA7 MICRO Shock Dyno: the shock absorber test bench built for race teams, service trucks, and workshops
signals.summary: Specialising in suspension measurement technologies, LABA7 is expanding its range with the MICRO Shock Dyno , a test bench designed for teams and workshops that need to test shock absorbers even when away from their main premises. The Micro Shock Dyno test bench features a closed-loop servomotor equipped with a multi-turn absolute encoder, capable of maintaining speeds between 1 and 1,000 mm/s even as the load varies. The equipment includes a 10 kN load cell and a non-contact temperature sensor, with a reading range from -40 to +150 °C. The system is controlled via the Shock Dyno v2 software, with Wi-Fi, USB and Ethernet connections. Standing 1,338 mm tall and with an operating weight of 65 kg, the Micro features removable uprights that reduce its height to 626 mm during transport . It is powered by a single-phase supply at 230 V or 110 V, and can also be operated via a generator or a socket fitted to a race van. Two fork adaptors with automatic preload are supplied as standard; additional mounts allow the test bench to be configured for car, motorbike and mountain bike shock absorbers. signals.summary: BYD Atto 2 Tantang Chery Q: Intip Perbandingan Performa dan Fitur JAKARTA, KOMPAS.com - Persaingan mobil listrik ringkas berpotensi semakin ramai dengan kehadiran BYD Atto 2 di Indonesia. Meski belum mengumumkan jadwal peluncuran dan spesifikasi lengkap Atto 2 di Tanah Air. Namun, apabila resmi dipasarkan, mobil listrik ini berpotensi menjadi rival dari Chery Q . Baca juga: Dilema Spare Part Vespa Matik, Kapan Boleh Pakai Komponen Non-Ori? BYD Atto 2 mengandalkan desain SUV ringkas dengan sejumlah pilihan kapasitas baterai pada model global, sedangkan Chery Q hadir dengan desain membulat, teknologi kabin modern, dan konfigurasi penggerak roda belakang (RWD). Presiden Direktur PT BYD Motor Indonesia Eagle Zhao sebelumnya mengatakan, Atto 2 akan diluncurkan setelah seluruh persiapan, termasuk kesiapan produksi di pabrik, terpenuhi. Mengenai Atto 2, juga akan diluncurkan dengan kesiapan dari pabrik semuanya dan termasuk dari Atto 2, ujar Eagle di Jakarta, Rabu (14/10/2026). Eagle juga memastikan Atto 2 untuk pasar Indonesia akan menggunakan Blade Battery generasi kedua atau Blade Battery 2.0 yang mendukung teknologi pengisian daya cepat Flash Charging . Lantas, bagaimana perbandingan spesifikasi BYD Atto 2 dan Chery Q? Dari sisi performa, berdasarkan spesifikasi global, BYD Atto 2 menggunakan satu motor listrik permanent magnet yang ditempatkan di bagian depan. Motor tersebut menghasilkan tenaga 70 kW atau 94 Tk dengan torsi maksimum 180 Nm. Pada model terbaru, BYD menyederhanakan pilihan motor menjadi satu konfigurasi tersebut untuk seluruh lima varian, termasuk varian dengan jarak tempuh 501 kilometer. signals.summary: Tren Downgrade Lifestyle: Benarkah Pembeli Mobil Beralih ke Motor? JAKARTA, KOMPAS.com Fenomena penurunan gaya hidup atau downgrade lifestyle belakangan ramai diperbincangkan masyarakat, termasuk dalam pemilihan kendaraan. Di tengah upaya menekan pengeluaran, sebagian konsumen memilih menjual mobil dan beralih menggunakan kendaraan yang lebih terjangkau, termasuk sepeda motor . Namun, apakah tren tersebut benar-benar membuat banyak konsumen mobil beralih membeli sepeda motor baru? Baca juga: Review Jujur Jaecoo J5 EV: Kelebihan, Kekurangan, dan Kisah Pengguna KOMPAS.com/DIO DANANJAYA Suasana booth Suzuki di Jakarta Fair 2026 Ketua Bidang Komersial Asosiasi Industri Sepeda Motor Indonesia (AISI) Yosef Utama mengatakan, segmen konsumen mobil dan sepeda motor memiliki karakteristik yang sangat berbeda. Karena itu, perpindahan konsumen yang membatalkan pembelian mobil baru lalu beralih membeli sepeda motor dinilai tidak signifikan. "Segmen pasar pembeli mobil dan motor itu sangat berbeda," kata Yosef kepada Kompas.com, dikutip Jumat (16/10/2026). Menurut dia, irisan antara konsumen yang membatalkan pembelian mobil baru dan kemudian membeli sepeda motor baru relatif kecil. Konsumen yang batal membeli mobil baru lebih cenderung beralih ke pasar mobil bekas , ujar Yosef. Dengan demikian, fenomena downgrade lifestyle di sektor otomotif tidak serta-merta berarti konsumen meninggalkan mobil dan beralih ke sepeda motor. Strategi tersebut memungkinkan pemilik kendaraan mengurangi penggunaan mobil untuk perjalanan yang sebenarnya dapat ditempuh menggunakan sepeda motor. Dengan begitu, biaya operasional kendaraan roda empat dapat ditekan tanpa harus menjual mobil atau membeli sepeda motor baru. Baca juga: Mengapa Motor Listrik Tak Selaris Mobil Listrik? Penyesuaian penggunaan kendaraan menjadi salah satu cara masyarakat mengatur pengeluaran di tengah kebutuhan rumah tangga yang beragam. signals.title: Mobil Listrik Pribadi Dipakai Taksi Online, Klaim Asuransi Bisa Batal
signals.summary: Mobil Listrik Pribadi Dipakai Taksi Online, Klaim Asuransi Bisa Batal JAKARTA, KOMPAS.com - Mobil listrik (EV) memang memiliki berbagai manfaat, efisien, hemat, dan sekarang mulai banyak yang harganya relatif terjangkau. Makanya sebagian pemilik EV tertarik memanfaatkan mobilnya untuk keperluan komersial, salah satunya dijadikan taksi online . Namun, perlu berhati-hati saat mendaftarkan dan menggunakan polis asuransi kendaraannya. Penggunaan mobil listrik yang tidak sesuai dengan status peruntukan awal yang dicantumkan dalam polis asuransi dapat berdampak fatal, yaitu hilangnya hak ganti rugi atau penolakan klaim saat terjadi insiden kecelakaan atau kerusakan. Baca juga: Asuransi Mobil Listrik: Lindungi Pihak Ketiga dari Kebakaran SPKLU? Head of Communication Asuransi Astra, Laurentius Iwan, menjelaskan bahwa hingga saat ini belum ada skema tarif khusus dari regulator yang membedakan penentuan premi mobil listrik dengan mobil konvensional. Penentuan besaran premi masih mengacu pada aturan baku yang salah satunya memperhitungkan status peruntukan kendaraan. "Saat ini belum ada aturan khusus untuk tarif khusus EV. Premi asuransi kendaraan bermotor mengacu dari regulator adalah berdasarkan harga pertanggungan, wilayah atau plat nopol, usia mobil, penggunaan apakah komersial atau pribadi," ujar Iwan kepada Kompas.com, belum lama ini. Iwan menegaskan bahwa kendati kendaraan yang digunakan berbasis baterai dan memiliki teknologi tinggi, acuan payung hukum dan syarat polis yang digunakan di Indonesia masih bersumber pada ketentuan yang sama. "Saat ini asuransi mobil masih menggunakan wording polis yang sama yaitu PSAKBI, baik untuk mobil combustion, hybrid, EV," kata Iwan. Baca juga: Dilema Spare Part Vespa Matik, Kapan Boleh Pakai Komponen Non-Ori? Ketentuan mengenai status penggunaan kendaraan diatur secara terperinci dalam Polis Standar Asuransi Kendaraan Bermotor Indonesia (PSAKBI). Bisa dilihat dalam Bab III Pasal 4 Ayat 12, Penggunaan Pribadi diartikan sebagai penggunaan kendaraan untuk kepentingan angkutan pribadi pengguna. Sementara pada Ayat 13, Penggunaan Komersial didefinisikan sebagai penggunaan kendaraan untuk disewakan atau menerima balas jasa. Apabila mobil listrik terdaftar dalam polis dengan kategori Penggunaan Pribadi, namun dalam praktiknya difungsikan untuk menarik penumpang taksi online atau disewakan, hal ini dikategorikan sebagai pelanggaran kesepakatan polis. Berdasarkan PSAKBI Bab II Pasal 3 Ayat 1.1.4, pertanggungan asuransi secara tegas tidak menjamin kerugian, kerusakan, atau biaya yang disebabkan saat kendaraan digunakan untuk "penggunaan selain dari yang dicantumkan dalam Polis." Tak hanya itu, aturan dalam PSAKBI Pasal 6 mengenai Kewajiban Untuk Mengungkapkan Fakta menegaskan bahwa tertanggung wajib menyampaikan informasi dan fakta material yang benar mengenai penggunaan kendaraan. Jika pemilik menyembunyikan fakta penggunaan komersial saat mendaftar, pihak penanggung berhak menolak membayar kerugian serta menghentikan pertanggungan secara sepihak. Oleh sebab itu, pemilik mobil listrik yang berniat memanfaatkan kendaraannya untuk operasional taksi online atau angkutan sewaan diimbau untuk menyampaikan status penggunaan komersial tersebut sejak awal pendaftaran polis. Meski premi penggunaan komersial berbeda, langkah ini menjamin kepastian jaminan ganti rugi apabila terjadi hal yang tidak diinginkan di jalan. Bayangkan seorang anak Indonesia bercita-cita menjadi dokter tetapi hanya memiliki satu buku lusuh untuk belajar. Bersama Ekspedisi Kata ke Nyata Kompas.com, Anda bisa membantu mengubah kisah itu. signals.title: Valentino Rossi Kasih Wejangan untuk Nicolo Bulega Jelang MotoGP 2027
signals.summary: Valentino Rossi Kasih Wejangan untuk Nicolo Bulega Jelang MotoGP 2027 JAKARTA, KOMPAS.com - Nicolo Bulega mengungkapkan pesan yang disampaikan Valentino Rossi setelah dirinya memastikan gelar juara dunia World Superbike (WorldSBK) 2026. Pebalap Ducati tersebut berhasil mengunci gelar juara dunia di Sirkuit Cremona, Italia, bulan lalu. Bulega memastikan gelar tersebut saat kompetisi masih menyisakan dua putaran. Bulega tampil dominan sepanjang musim 2026 dengan memenangi hampir seluruh balapan. Ia hanya gagal meraih kemenangan dalam empat balapan dan finis di posisi kedua pada kesempatan tersebut. Menjelang kepindahannya ke MotoGP pada 2027, Bulega mengaku mendapat pesan dari Rossi yang akan menjadi bosnya di tim VR46 Ducati musim depan. Baca juga: Dilema Spare Part Vespa Matik, Kapan Boleh Pakai Komponen Non-Ori? Bulega mengatakan Rossi mengapresiasi kerja kerasnya setelah berhasil meraih gelar juara dunia WorldSBK. "Dia mengucapkan selamat atas pekerjaan yang telah saya lakukan. Sekarang saya harus memikirkan tugas-tugas yang ada di depan," ucap Bulega, mengutip Crash.net , Kamis (15/10/2026). Gelar juara dunia WorldSBK 2026 menjadi modal penting bagi Bulega sebelum menjalani tantangan baru di MotoGP musim depan. Pebalap asal Italia tersebut sebelumnya merupakan anggota VR46 Riders Academy sebelum beralih ke kejuaraan World Superbike pada 2022. Pada tahun ini, Ducati juga menunjuk Bulega sebagai pebalap penguji untuk proyek motor bermesin 850 cc. Penunjukan tersebut sempat dipandang sebagai jalan baginya untuk mendapatkan tempat di MotoGP pada 2027. Namun, persaingan dalam bursa transfer pebalap sempat membuat masa depan Bulega di kelas premier diragukan. Kini, Bulega dipastikan akan melangkah ke MotoGP bersama VR46 Ducati, tim milik Valentino Rossi . Meski datang dengan status juara dunia WorldSBK, Bulega menyadari bahwa persaingan di MotoGP akan menghadirkan tantangan berbeda. Ia bahkan mengakui, dominasinya di WorldSBK musim ini membuatnya terbiasa dengan situasi ketika finis kedua terasa seperti hasil yang mengecewakan. "Ketika Anda kembali ke pit setelah balapan dan posisi kedua menjadi hasil terburuk, secara mental Anda memasuki dunia yang tidak nyata. Terlebih lagi, kondisi itu tidak akan terjadi di MotoGP," kata Bulega.
